title: Algerian Aubergine Tagine
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from North Africa. This dish combines the rich flavors of algerian spices with the comforting taste of aubergine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the algerian spice mix and stir for 1 minute.
Add the aubergine pieces and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the broth, sugar, and crushed tomatoes.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and let cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the aubergine is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
